quotes.action_taken: action_taken  Description: The action taken on the covered loan or application Values: 1 - Loan originated 2 - Application approved but not accepted 3 - Application denied 4 - Application withdrawn by applicant 5 - File closed for incompleteness 6 - Purchased loan 7 - Preapproval request denied 8 - Preapproval request approved but
quotes.loan_purpose: loan_purpose  Description: The purpose of covered loan or application Values: 1 - Home purchase 2 - Home improvement 31 - Refinancing 32 - Cash-out refinancing 4 - Other purpose 5 - Not applicable lien_status  Description: Lien status of the property securing the covered loan, or in the case of an application, proposed to secure
quotes.lien_status: lien_status  Description: Lien status of the property securing the covered loan, or in the case of an application, proposed to secure the covered loan Values: 1 - Secured by a first lien 2 - Secured by a subordinate lien reverse_mortgage  Description: Whether the covered loan or application is for a reverse mortgage Values: 1 - Reverse
quotes.loan_amount: loan_amount  Description: The amount of the covered loan, or the amount applied for Values: Varying values
quotes.loan_term: loan_term  Description: The number of months after which the legal obligation will mature or terminate, or would have matured or terminated Values: Varying values
quotes.total_loan_costs: total_loan_costs  Description: The amount, in dollars, of total loan costs Values: Varying values

terms.note: No data-use terms page was found on the hosts this environment can reach (ffiec.cfpb.gov, files.ffiec.cfpb.gov). The CFPB website terms and the HMDA pages on consumerfinance.gov are behind a blocked host (www.consumerfinance.gov, proxy 403). HMDA public data are published by the CFPB/FFIEC for public use, but no sentence to that effect was quoted, so DX-H4 is OPEN for this source: the owner (or a session that can reach consumerfinance.gov) must quote the terms before release.

observations.loanAmountBinned: loan_amount values in the public data end in 5,000 (e.g. 115000, 225000, 375000): amounts are published binned, so medians of loan_amount are bin midpoints
